violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff not wash hands before putting on new gloves. Observed staff not wash hands before scooping ice cream.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO WASH HANDS BEFORE ENGAGING IN FOOD PREPARATION (IE: SCOOPING ICE CREAM) AND BEFORE PUTTING ON NEW GLOVES. SEE WHEN TO WASH HAND OUT. BRIGHTVIEW GREAT FALLS (Inspection Date: 09/10/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed no hand soap at the hand sink next to the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. MAINTENANCE REPAIRED AND REFILLED SOAP DISPENSER. HAND SOAP MUST BE AVAILABLE AT THE HAND SINK TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Observed can opener with accumulation of debris on its blade
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC TOOK THE CAN OPENER TO THE DISH MACHINE. CLEAN CAN OPENER AFTER USING.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed a rack of food storage containers and mixing bowls being washed in the high temperature dish machine. Using PIC’s high temperature dish plate, dish machine was observed at 156f
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO RUN THE MACHINE AGAIN UNTIL THE TEMPERATURE REACHED A MINIMUM OF 160f. DISH PLATE WAS OBSERVED AT 169f AFTER ONE ADDITIONAL CYCLE.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean Every 24 Hours
violations.observation: Observed bun butter roller with an accumulation of debris on the inside of the container. Bun butter roller container was observed holding shelf stable butter alternative.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours for iced tea dispensers and consumer self-service utensils such as tongs, scoops, or ladles. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO CLEAN THE BUN BUTTER ROLLER AT THE END OF THE DAY. PIC AGREED TO CLEAN THE EQUIPMENT MORE OFTEN.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Observed the under side of the beverage dispensers and the counter top ice machine with an accumulation black slime.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) on the grill, burger patties were observed at 100f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC. DISCARDED THE BURGER PATTIES. HOT HOLD TCS FOODS AT A MINIMUM OF 135f.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) corned beef 2) vanilla pudding 3) sour cream
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed two unlabeled spray bottles of cleaning products
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC LABELED THE CLEANING PRODUCTS. LABEL ALL CHEMICAL BOTTLES.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Commercially reduced oxygen packaged salmon was observed fully thawed in the prep top cooler. Packaging was observed intact
violations.corrective_action: CUT OPEN THE PACKAGING OF ALL REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGED FROZEN FISH FOR PROPER THAWING.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed flying insects in the upstairs and downstairs serveries.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC PROVIDED THE CONTRACT FOR THEIR FACILITIES’ LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR. SERVICES ARE PROVIDED FOR RODENTS, COCKROACHES, AND GENERAL PESTS. CONTACT YOUR LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR TO ENSURE FLYING INSECTS ARE TREATED.
